items.q: What should you remember about uS AI lead is **moderate not decisive**?
items.a: **China catching up quickly;** export controls haven't prevented competitive models.

items.q: What should you remember about **Deployment infrastructure > model sophistication**?
items.a: **electrical power, factories, iteration** speed determine who benefits from AI rollout.

items.q: What should you remember about china built **1,500 ships** last year; US built **~5**?
items.a: **industrial capacity gap dwarfs AI benchmark gaps.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Dark factories**?
items.a: **lights off, minimal human workers** — plus dense ecosystem of battery/sensor/EV suppliers next door.

items.q: Why does this matter: **Engineer-led state** excels at physical infrastructure; fails when it **social-engineers** people (one-child?
items.a: **Engineer-led state** excels at physical infrastructure; fails when it **social-engineers** people (one-child policy).

items.q: What should you remember about **Anaconda in chandelier**?
items.a: **censorship works through ambient** fear, not constant visible punishment.

items.q: What should you remember about **Both countries self-sabotage**?
items.a: **leader overconfidence (Xi property** smash, Trump tariffs/deportations) vs trailing-country urgency.

items.q: What should you remember about don't trade vibrant manufacturing ecosystem for marginally better AI models?
items.a: **Don't trade vibrant manufacturing** ecosystem for marginally better AI models.

items.q: Why does this matter: Silicon Valley founders inspirational but **don't deliver** orderly streets, affordable housing, clean cities ?
items.a: Silicon Valley founders inspirational but **don't deliver** orderly streets, affordable housing, clean cities to ordinary Americans.

items.q: What should you remember about young workers in AI-exposed jobs seeing **16% slower employment growth**?
What should you remember about **Made in China** brand trajectory → premium quality parity with Germany/Japan within a decade?
items.a: **Made in China** brand trajectory → premium quality parity with Germany/Japan within a decade.
